evals.prompt: 네이버 뉴스 IT/과학 탭(https://news.naver.com/section/105)에서 AI 관련 기사 3개 정도 스크랩해서, 보고서(워드)랑 발표자료(PPT) 둘 다 만들어줘. 스크린샷도 같이 넣어줘.
evals.expected_output: 3 articles scraped via Playwright with full-page screenshots saved under output/playwright/; a shared JSON built with an Overview section, one section per article (headline, source, summary, key points, embedded screenshot), and closing/sources sections; a .docx report and a .pptx deck both generated from that JSON, both containing the article screenshots, styled in Malgun Gothic with a consistent main color.
expectations: Both a .docx and a .pptx file are produced
The content covers approximately 3 distinct AI-related articles
The .docx report has at least one embedded screenshot image
The .pptx deck has at least one slide with an embedded screenshot image
Text in the .docx uses Malgun Gothic (맑은 고딕) font
Saved screenshots are real, non-trivial captures
